Sometimes, children find it easier to talk about their feelings when they’re not talking about themselves. ❤️📚

A story character can become a safe little window into big emotions—anger, fear, sadness, shyness, friendship and everything in between.

And somewhere between talking about the character, they might just start talking about themselves.

That’s the quiet magic of reading together. ✨

Want to raise a little reader? Don't worry about building a perfect routine.

Start with one book. 📖

One story becomes another.
Another becomes a library visit.
Library visits become a routine.
And one day, your child walks to the shelf and says:

“I want this one.” ❤️

That's how reading habits grow — naturally, joyfully and at their own pace.

Your child may not be ready to read independently yet — but they’re ready to listen, imagine and learn. 📚❤️

Reading aloud builds vocabulary, strengthens listening skills, sparks imagination, and creates beautiful moments of connection.

So pick a book. Find a cosy corner. And read to them.

Because reading aloud is learning aloud. ✨

Give them the freedom to explore different stories, discover their interests and find the books they want to return to.

Because every little exploration is a step towards becoming a reader. 📚
